why: The bands' two-decimal edges are compared against unrounded measures, so a board at the shipped route-count maximum, 7/3 = 2.333..., reads OUTSIDE the 1.00-2.33 band that maximum defines, and every such board lowers the in-band share the issue reports.
killedBy: the shipped bands and the in-band share (issue #1029) counts a value inside at two decimals as inside, the shipped 7/3 route count included
